$comment: Structured tournament format for every men's T20 World Cup, 2007-2026. Hand-compiled 2026-10-28 from Wikipedia edition pages (format sections + group tables), the official ICC Playing Conditions PDFs for 2021/2022/2024/2026 (clause 16.10 Competition Format) and ICC/media explainers; see research_notes/T20 modifiers and ratings evidence/formats_and_rules.md for sources and open questions. Team names use Cricsheet spellings. Conventions: 'groups' lists teams in each group AS SEEDED/PLACED BEFORE RESULTS (seed labels in 'seeds' where the ICC published them); for Super stages 'slots' gives the pre-assigned seed slots that define each group, 'seededTeams' the teams those slots were allocated to before the tournament, and 'actualTeams' who ended up there. 'carriedOverPoints' is whether first-stage results counted in the next stage (false in every edition: the Super stage was always a fresh table). 'knockoutPairing' uses stage-group labels. 'afghanistan' records Afghanistan's slot at each stage so a stand-in can be slotted identically (stand-in choice lives in editions.json).

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each group advance to the Super 8. Super 8 groups were PRE-SEEDED: seeds A1, B2, C1, D2 go to Group E and A2, B1, C2, D1 to Group F regardless of group finish (New Zealand kept C1 despite finishing below Sri Lanka). A third seed that qualified ahead of a seed took that seed's slot (Bangladesh took A2/West Indies' Group F place).

stages.name: Super 8
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each Super 8 group to the semi-finals.
stages.knockoutPairing: E2 v F1 (SF1, Cape Town); E1 v F2 (SF2, Durban)

Super 8 groups PRE-SEEDED, 'not affected by group stage results': Group E = top seed of A and C + second seed of B and D (A1, C1, B2, D2); Group F = top seed of B and D + second seed of A and C (B1, D1, A2, C2). A non-seeded team that knocked out a seed inherits that seed (not triggered in 2010).

stages.name: First Round
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each group advance, BY POSITION: 'The winner of Group A and the runner-up of Group B shall be placed in Group 1 of the Super 12s. The winner of Group B and the runner-up of Group A shall be placed in Group 2' (ICC PC 16.10.2). (Pre-tournament the ICC had intended Sri Lanka/Bangladesh to keep A1/B1 if they qualified; this was dropped after Scotland topped Group B.)
tiebreakers: head-to-head (points, then NRR in that match)

stages.advancement: Top 2 of each Super 12 group to the semi-finals. Eight direct entrants placed by ICC T20I rankings (cut-off 31 Dec 2018, re-seeded 20 Mar 2021).
tiebreakers: head-to-head (points, then NRR in that match)

stages.name: First Round

stages.name: Super 12
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each Super 12 group to the semi-finals. Direct entrants: 2021 finalists + next six by T20I rankings at 15 Nov 2021.

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each group advance to the Super 8. PRE-SEEDED: 'The top two teams that qualify for the Second Round from each First Round Group will retain their seeding from the First Round ... regardless of whether they finished first or second in the Group. If A4 qualified instead of A1, A4 would assume the schedule of A1' (ICC PC 16.10.1). Super 8 Group 1 = A1, B2, C1, D2; Group 2 = A2, B1, C2, D1. 'No points are carried forward from the First Round to the Second Round.'

stages.name: Super 8
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each Super 8 group to the semi-finals. Teams start the Super 8 on zero points.
stages.knockoutPairing: 1st Group 1 v 2nd Group 2 (SF2, Guyana 27 Jun: India v England); 1st Group 2 v 2nd Group 1 (SF1, Trinidad 26 Jun: South Africa v Afghanistan)

stages.name: Semi-finals

placement.outcome: 1st in group (3-1); as a non-seed qualifying ahead of New Zealand they took the C1 slot

placement.slot: 2nd Group 1 (SF1 v 1st Group 2 South Africa, Trinidad)

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each group advance to the Super Eights. PRE-ASSIGNED by ICC PC 16.10.1: the eight seeded teams 'will compete in pre-assigned groups': Group 1 = X1 India (A1), X2 Australia (B1), X3 West Indies (C2), X4 South Africa (D2); Group 2 = Y1 England (C1), Y2 New Zealand (D1), Y3 Pakistan (A2), Y4 Sri Lanka (B2). A non-seeded qualifier takes the slot of the eliminated seed from its group; if neither seed qualifies, the group winner takes seed 1's slot and the runner-up seed 2's. Zimbabwe (Group B winner) took Australia's X2 slot. Because of how the seeds were allocated, every group winner landed in Group 1 and every runner-up in Group 2.

stages.name: Super 8
stages.advancement: Top 2 of each Super Eights group to the semi-finals. 'Teams will start the Super Eights with zero points. No points, wins or net run rate from the first round will be carried forward.' Group 1 played mainly in India, Group 2 in Sri Lanka.
stages.knockoutPairing: 1st Group 1 v 2nd Group 2 (SF1, Kolkata 4 Mar: South Africa v New Zealand); 1st Group 2 v 2nd Group 1 (SF2, Mumbai 5 Mar: England v India). Venue rule: SF1 moves to Colombo if Pakistan qualify; India play SF2 in Mumbai unless facing Pakistan.

stages.name: Semi-finals
stages.advancement: Winners to the final (Ahmedabad 8 Mar; India beat New Zealand by 96 runs)

placement.outcome: 3rd (2-2, 4 pts; tied with South Africa and lost the second Super Over), eliminated
